description: Declared set of Nishfleet repos enrolled in the agent-ready queue (.github/workflows/agent-dispatch.yml and the scout job); a PR against this file is the enrolment.
preconditions: Every enrolled repo MUST have (a) a git checkout at <checkout_root>/<name> and (b) all three `required_labels` present on the repo. `agent-dispatch` fires only on the `agent-ready` label.

excluded.name: fleet2
excluded.reason: Forbidden second dispatcher. Standing rule 'One fleet — No second dispatcher, ever' (vault _system/shared-memory/global-standing-rules.md, 'One fleet'): a second fleet spends its effort on itself. fleet2 must NEVER be enrolled regardless of labels or checkout state.

deferred.name: fleet-ops
deferred.reason: Tripwire tripped. Nish 2026-09-22: 'protect compute. no bs should be built in the first place, rather than being blocked at gates.' Last 24h on fleet-ops: 149 merged PRs vs 45 on 0509; of the 149, 50 are docs/observe-close/reports the fleet writes about itself, 36 are Jev shadow/advisory tiers whose own text says they change nothing, 0 touch the product. 100 open agent-ready issues, all self-filed by the worker bot (worker files findings, intake labels them agent-ready, a worker claims them: a self-feeding loop). Control-plane work now enters ONLY as a packet scoped by Fable or Nish: a repair upstream of a product outcome (dead lane, seat wall, a gate that let a D-grade PR merge). No auto-intake, no scout, no worker-exit top-up on this repo. Re-enrol via PR when the fleet-ops:0509 merge ratio inverts on product supply, not before.

deferred.name: siterep-public
deferred.reason: 0509-exclusive campaign (decisions ledger 2026-08-26): new product supply targets 0509 ONLY for the next days/weeks — 'big epic changes to make it undisputed segment best'. Existing PRs/issues drain normally; re-enrol via PR when Nish widens scope. fleet-ops stays enrolled solely to finish the mechanical stack + gap-closure loop, ratio line as tripwire.
deferred.maintenance_queue: AGENT_MODE=live since 2026-09-25 for the no-glue cleanup epics only (Nish: "clean up everything then"). Maintenance, which the 2026-08-25 ledger allows; product supply stays 0509-only.
